comments.author: kind
comments.text: Decision: defer Noro eval for now. Noro inference is diffusion over mel frames (reverse_diffusion loop) and also needs a compatible mel vocoder (hop=200/win=800) which is not bundled; likely to miss realtime targets. Revisit only if FreeVC/YingMusic/FACodec listening results are unsatisfactory.

comments.text: Re-checked in-repo Noro inference (models/vc/Noro/noro_inference.py): outputs mel only (recon_mel.npy) and uses diffusion inference_steps=200 by default, with no bundled waveform vocoder in the inference path. Given the call-UX target and the current strong ClassicVC results, keep Noro deferred/reject for now unless we want to invest in a full vocoder + aggressive step reduction.

title: VC quest: fix speaker similarity=0 in stream scoring
description: In FreeVC user_pair_search_call_end, many *_stream_*.report.json have speaker_similarity_target/source=0.0 (inconsistent) causing call_score_v1 to clamp to 0 and best_streaming.json to be meaningless. Debug the scorer path (likely evaluation/vc_quest/score_user_pair_dir.py / score_outputs.py / evaluation/vevo_live/common.py), ensure correct audio files are embedded, handle missing/invalid audio with explicit NaNs + warnings (not silent zeros), then rescore the run dir and regenerate best_streaming.json with meaningful rankings.
notes: Fix: select_best now reads speaker_similarity_target (fallback speaker_similarity). score_user_pair_dir writes report_version and only resumes if current version. glitch_metrics baseline uses p99 abs(diff) so boundary_jump_ratio is ~0-10 not ~200+, making call_score_v1 meaningful. Vast rescore: runs/vc_quest/freevc/user_pair_search_call_end/best_streaming.json now selects w600/h300 with mean_call_score_v1≈0.149 (tier=quality, eligible=11/20). Commit: 02f1f97.
